result: To find the root θ of an unknown monotone response M(x) = α from noisy measurements, update x_{n+1} = x_n + a_n(α − y_n) with gains satisfying Σa_n² < ∞ and (essentially) Σa_n = ∞, e.g. a_n = 1/n: then E(x_n − θ)² → 0 and x_n → θ in probability — the ancestor of stochastic gradient descent.
result_plain: Robbins–Monro stochastic approximation: decreasing gains (Σa=∞, Σa²<∞) give convergence to the root; ancestor of SGD.
